item.title: 利用大语言模型免训练监测 SCF 收敛：以 VASP 计算磁性过渡金属氧化物为例
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该工作围绕第一性原理计算中自洽场迭代的收敛监测展开，重点考察大语言模型在无需额外训练条件下识别 VASP 计算状态的可行性。研究对象为磁性过渡金属氧化物，这类体系常因磁有序、强关联或初始态敏感而出现收敛困难。摘要信息较少，具体模型提示方式、评估指标和适用边界需查阅原文。

item.title: 含水侵入条件下 DGEBA/MTHPA 环氧体系的机器学习势
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该文发表于《Computational Materials Science》，主题是为 DGEBA/MTHPA 环氧树脂在水分侵入条件下建立或应用机器学习原子间势。由于原始摘要仅提供出版信息，具体训练数据、模型形式、验证精度及水侵入对结构或性能的影响需查阅原文。该工作预计面向聚合物材料在湿热环境中的分子模拟与性能预测。

item.title: 范德华呼吸 kagome 化合物 Nb₃Cl₈ 中的呼吸铁电性、平带与多重手性声子
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Yilun Yu, Fengrui Sui, Beituo Liu, Shuai Yang, Changjun Li, Ruofan Li 等15位作者
该研究表明，范德华材料 Nb₃Cl₈ 同时具有可翻转电极化、异常平坦的电子能带以及手性晶格振动。作者将其归因于呼吸 kagome 晶格结构，为探索关联量子态、铁电调控和纳米器件功能提供了多自由度平台。

item.title: Medium-Throughput Evaluation of Quantum Geometry-Driven Topological Transports in Altermagnets
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Fu Li, Bo Zhao, Vikrant Chaudhary, Shengqiao Wang, Chen Shen, Hao Wang 等7位作者
Altermagnets provide a promising platform for a wide spectrum of applications integrating advantages of conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. In this work, we implement a medium-throughput first-principles workflow and evaluate topological transport properties driven by quantum geometry for 135 altermagnets in the MAGNDATA database. Based on automated Wannier construction, both linear and nonlinear responses, including the anomalous Hall effect, magneto-optical Kerr effect, and bulk photovoltaic effect, are evaluated with further symmetry verifications. Detailed analysis is done on representative cases like metallic VNb3S6 with enhanced anomalous Hall conductivity, CaIrO3 with giant MOKE, and CuFeS2 with large shift current in non-centrosymmetric. item.title: Analysis of Casing Loads in Coalbed Methane Horizontal Wells during Multi-Stage Hydraulic Fracturing
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Qiang Miao, Zhili Zhang, Zenglong Wang, Jinliang Han, Yipu Chen, Gan Yang 等9位作者
China has abundant deep coalbed methane resources, totaling 40.71 trillion m³, of which more than 30% are distributed in the Ordos Basin. During multi-stage hydraulic fracturing of deep coal seams, fracture propagation induces complex stress redistribution, resulting in abnormal casing stress increases and higher risks of yielding, deformation, and failure. High-flow-rate and large-scale fracturing operations further intensify casing stress responses. To address the strong heterogeneity of deep coal seams and the limited applicability of existing induced-stress models, this study focuses on the Taiyuan Formation coal seam in the Daniudi Gas Field, Ordos Basin. item.title: Boron layers could set a superconductivity record, theoretical study predicts
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Scientists in China predict that stacking two microscopic layers of boron could set a new record for superconductivity. Superconductors are materials that conduct electricity with zero resistance. Traditional types need temperatures close to absolute zero to work, requiring complex and expensive cooling equipment.

item.title: 穿越到镜像世界：粒子化作雾缕，磁单极悖论随之消解
item.description:
📚 Physics News
这篇物理新闻以歌德《魔王》中“只是一缕雾”的意象引入量子世界中的镜像世界概念。文章意在说明，在某些理论框架下，粒子态可呈现类似“雾缕”的非经典表象，并可能为磁单极相关悖论提供新的理解路径。具体物理模型与论证细节需查阅原文。

item.title: New 'shape-shifting' architecture brings versatility to photonic quantum computing
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Using light to process quantum information is one of the most promising approaches to building future quantum computers. Light particles, known as photons, are excellent carriers of quantum information, but their lack of natural interactions has created a major challenge for researchers seeking to build systems capable of performing a full range of computations.

item.title: Tiny floating magnet detects ultrafaint magnetic fields at room temperature
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Measuring faint magnetic fields is useful in a number of areas, including mapping brain activity, monitoring hearts and probing fundamental physics. Typically, picking up such weak signals requires expensive or bulky equipment, such as liquid-helium cooling tanks or specially shielded rooms that block out Earth's magnetic field.

item.title: Physicists watch a material's electrons assemble, and reassemble, into coexisting phases
item.description:
📚 Physics News
A tall glass of ice water isn't just a thirst quencher; it's also an everyday example of coexisting phases. Water can exist simultaneously in both liquid and solid phases. As it turns out, this phase duality can also exist in more exotic quantum materials, in ways that are far more complicated to tease apart.

item.title: High-Accuracy Surface Defect Detection for Metal Strips: Lightweight YOLOv5s-SC2 with LAMP Pruning
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Lifang Pan, Manman Chen, Guangming Liu, Lifeng Ma
To address the challenges of diverse surface defect types, significant scale variations, and the high miss rate of small targets, a novel YOLOv5s-SC surface defect detection model for metal strips is proposed based on the YOLOv5s architecture. First, the K-means + + algorithm is adopted to optimize anchor box generation, and the Shape-IoU loss function is introduced to enhance bounding box regression accuracy.
